title: Ella Enchanted
author: Gail Carson Levine
summary: Ella of Frell was given the gift of obedience by a careless fairy, which means she must do whatever she is told. Determined to break the spell, she sets out into a world of ogres, elves and giants.
readIf: you want a funny, light fairy-tale retelling with a feisty heroine.
skipIf: you prefer dark or complex fantasy.

pairings.reason: Another Cinderella-inspired heroine, with a futuristic and more serious setting.
A fairy tale with more satire and swordplay, that also never takes itself too seriously.
A fairy-tale adventure for older readers, with a quest and a sly sense of humour.
